confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated but mixed-date sources: crowdsourced cost-of-living sites with small samples, Shanghai and Beijing data used as a cross-check, and travel-blog reports for Qingdao. Beer, cappuccino and meal anchors are better supported than cocktail and wine. No source gave a wine-by-the-glass price, so wine_glass is set at roughly three times the beer anchor, a local price-relationship judgement. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and comparable-city context only. No accommodation searches were run, no booking pages or listings were inspected, and July is peak beach-season pricing, so these are rough. Yuan prices were converted at approximate rates, so USD values will drift with the exchange rate. The FX value comes from a search result for the RBA exchange-rates page dated 16 October 2026; it may be provisional relative to the 4 pm fixing, and I did not open the page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Food and drink are anchored to Chinese tier-2 coastal city pricing, with Qingdao-specific travel reports for local meals and Shanghai and Beijing crowdsourced averages as a ceiling for bar and cafe prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Chinese coastal resort city in peak summer season.
